conflicts.finding: VW/Audi spans PQ, MQB, MEB, MLB, J1, PPE and PPC.
Audi/VAG OBDb contains FC00/FE00xx targeted command syntax.
conflicts.resolution: Keep non-executable until exact raw transport is normalized and physically captured.

conflicts.finding: 2022 RS e-tron GT explicitly rejects many VAG make-level MQB/PQ candidates.
conflicts.resolution: Store rejection as model/platform-scoped negative evidence; reduce scan budget on J1 without affecting MQB/MEB.

conflicts.finding: OEM sources confirm PPE/PPC/E3 architectures, but this pass did not establish safe public diagnostic route sets.
conflicts.resolution: Terminal platform_known_route_knowledge_incomplete; do not inherit MQB/MLB routes.

conflicts.finding: SFD protects advanced changes, while read-only identification/measuring values are expected to remain available.
conflicts.resolution: No automatic unlock; continue read-only discovery.
